facts.text: The image is a multi-panel character reference sheet with one large panoramic hero image across the top and seven smaller labeled study panels below.
The top hero panel shows a large dark dragon in a volcanic, rocky landscape with glowing orange lava or embers and wet, reflective ground.

The dragon has a heavily built reptilian body, dark black-to-charcoal scales with blue-green iridescent highlights, long pale swept-back horns, numerous dorsal spines, large bat-like wings, a long spiked tail, and clawed limbs.
In the hero image, the dragon stands low on its limbs with its wings partly raised and its long tail extending toward the right.
The middle-left panel labeled FRONT shows the dragon facing the viewer with its wings spread wide and its tail visible behind.
The middle-center panel labeled SIDE PROFILE shows the dragon in lateral view facing left, with its wings raised and tail extending to the right.
The middle-right panel labeled REAR shows the dragon from behind with its wings spread to both sides and its tail hanging downward.
The bottom-left panel labeled HEAD CLOSE shows a close-up of the dragon's head in profile, including the eye, horn array, and scaly snout.
The bottom second panel labeled WING MEMBRANE shows a close-up of the dark, leathery wing membrane and its supporting finger structure.
The bottom third panel labeled CLAW AND FOOT shows a close-up of a scaly foot with large curved claws.
The bottom-right panel labeled SCALE DETAIL shows tightly overlapping dark scales with blue-green iridescent reflections.
Visible panel labels in white uppercase text are FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, REAR, HEAD CLOSE, WING MEMBRANE, CLAW AND FOOT, and SCALE DETAIL.

Lighting is cinematic and low-key in the hero panel, with warm orange glow from the volcanic background and cool blue rim highlights on the dragon; the study panels use neutral, soft lighting against a plain dark background.
The overall palette is dominated by black, charcoal, smoke gray, metallic blue-green, pale ivory, and ember orange.
